overview.title: Start here
overview.body: Choose a card to open a tool. Check the device overview, then open the relevant page for details or an action.

file_manager.title: File manager
file_manager.body: Choose a folder from the sidebar to browse, search, copy, or move items. Deleted items go to the Recycle Bin.

apps.title: Installed apps
apps.body: Search by app name or publisher. Remove launches the app's official uninstaller after confirmation; size may be unavailable for some apps.

storage.title: See what uses disk space
storage.body: Choose a drive or folder and scan it. Results rank large folders and files for review; scanning does not delete anything.

cleanup.title: Safe temporary cleanup
cleanup.body: Scan categories first, review the selected items and space, then confirm cleanup. Personal, active, or protected files are skipped.

performance.title: Monitor device performance
performance.body: CPU, memory, and disk show current usage. The process list is a snapshot; refresh it manually and check processes before ending them.

duplicates.title: Review duplicate files before removal
duplicates.body: Choose a folder and scan file contents for matches. Review each group and keep a copy; selected items go to the Recycle Bin after confirmation.

tools.title: Windows tools
tools.body: Search or choose a category, then launch a tool. Some open in a separate window and may require Windows administrator permission.

settings.title: Set up the app your way
settings.body: Change the language and metric refresh interval, and check administrator access. Reset returns preferences to defaults.
